mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Show the rows of a table or CDS view, or run an ABAP SQL SELECT.

description: [read-only] Reads the rows of the table or CDS view named by object_name, or the rows sql_query selects: every column of object_name, or what sql_query selects with its columns, conditions and order. Required: object_name or sql_query. Optional: max_rows (default 100). Response: JSON. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

object_name.description: Table or CDS view whose rows are read, all columns. Used when sql_query is absent.

sql_query.description: ABAP SQL SELECT naming the columns, conditions and order to read.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP.

name: HandlerGetData
